chapter.heading: Greeting
chapter.v:
Paul, an
apostle of Jesus Christ, by the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ, our hope, [Eph. 3:1]

To Timothy,
a true son in the faith:Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.No Other Doctrine [Col. 4:17 1 NU]

As I
urged you when I went into Macedonia—remain in Ephesus that you may charge some that they teach no other doctrine, [1 Cor. 6:11;]

nor give
heed to fables and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than godly edification which is in faith. [Eph. 1:16;] [Titus 2:11]

Now the
purpose of the commandment is love from a pure heart, from a good conscience, and from sincere faith, [[Rom. 3:20];] [Eph. 1:15; Col.]

from which
some, having strayed, have turned aside to idle talk, [Ezek. 36:26] [Phil. 1:9; [Col.]

desiring to
be teachers of the law, understanding neither what they say nor the things which they affirm. [[Matt. 25:34];]

But we
know that the law is good if one uses it lawfully, [1 Tim. 1:15]

knowing this:
that the law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and for sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers, [1 Tim. 1:4;]

according to
the glorious gospel of the blessed God which was committed to my trust.Glory to God for His Grace

And I
thank Christ Jesus our Lord who has enabled me, because He counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry, [Acts 20:4;]

although I
was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor, and an insolent man; but I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief. [Acts 18:24;]

And the
grace of our Lord was exceedingly abundant, with faith and love which are in Christ Jesus. [2 Cor. 9:7;]

This is
a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.

However, for
this reason I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might show all longsuffering, as a pattern to those who are going to believe on Him for everlasting life. [Eph. 6:5; Col.]

Now to
the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.Fight the Good Fight

This charge
I commit to you, son Timothy, according to the prophecies previously made concerning you, that by them you may wage the good warfare,

having faith
and a good conscience, which some having rejected, concerning the faith have suffered shipwreck, [1 Cor. 16:21;]

of whom
are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they may learn not to blaspheme.
